snippet.title: Loose Dog: Trailer
snippet.description:
Your dog Pepper keeps getting out of the house each night. Brave the woods behind your house and bring her back.

Play on itch io:
https://trashmonger.itch.io/loose-dog


A short horror game I made in a week for Duke Jam! This is my first ever horror game and really atmosphere-y experience. Highly recommend playing in the dark and with headphones!
